data.script: Erik: Counting mission, final report! Books on the shelf: sixty-three. … Erik: Pencils in the big cup: twenty-eight. … Mateo: Steps from the door to the kitchen: fifteen. I counted them twice. … Erik: Photos on the wall: forty. All of them with Luna somewhere! … Mateo: And the biscuits… there were thirty this morning. … Erik: And now? … Mateo: Twenty-two. The mission was long. I needed energy! … Erik: Mission complete. More or less!
